1. Before you visit the store, create an inventory list of the store’s items and the prices of their items. This will help you plan ahead and avoid getting caught.

6. If you can, try to leave the store with at least one other person. Having an accomplice will make it less suspicious for anyone who might have been watching your every move.
7. Make sure to double check your bags and pockets after leaving the store to make sure nothing is loose or amiss.
